title: Feature Request: Follow System Theme
body: Please add an option to follow the system theme so I don't have to switch between light and dark mode manually : )
author: mak1A4

top_comments.author: kawpuh
top_comments.body: For linux, I recommend checking `gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme` as described in the [arch wiki](https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Dark_mode_switching#gsettings). At minimum ghostty and chromium seem to follow this setting for example.

top_comments.author: github-actions[bot]
top_comments.body: This issue has been inactive for 30 days. If the issue is still occurring, please comment to let us know. Otherwise, this issue will be automatically closed in 30 days for housekeeping purposes.
